og.titolo: Fair KM — trail races at a fair price
og.descrizione: Find races worth the effort, and the people who've really run them.
apertura.occhiello: Trail races · Italy and the UK
apertura.slogan: Find races worth the effort, and the people who've really run them.
metodo.titolo: Climbing counts. So does the price.
metodo.intro: Every 100 m of climbing counts as one kilometre. This is ITRA's km-effort, the measure of effort used in trail running. Divide the entry fee by those kilometres and any race can be compared with the others.
metodo.standard: We use the standard fee, not the lowest launch price. We show the other tiers alongside.
metodo.valuta: Always in the race's own currency, with the same thresholds for everyone. No conversions.
metodo.riferimento: Each race is measured against its own yardstick: in Italy, the Lavaredo distance closest in effort.
metodo.mancanti: What's missing, we say. If a cost isn't published, it stays blank: undeclared VAT and fees don't count as included.
fila.intro: The {{d.fila.totale}} long distances ({{d.soglia.km}} km and over) we've checked in Italy. {{d.fila.giusto}} are fairly priced. The hollow circles are Lavaredo, the reference.
fila.didascalia: Cost per km-effort, standard fee in euros. Tap or hover over a dot.
fila.tabella: See the data as a table
scheda.titolo: One race page, everything you need
scheda.intro: Course, requirements, what the fee includes and how it has changed. This is a race page with the real data we already have.
scheda.requisiti.indice: Minimum ITRA or UTMB index of 530 (men) / 450 (women).
scheda.requisiti.certificato: Medical certificate for competitive sport, for the pacer too.
scheda.in_arrivo: Map and profile from the official GPX, cut-off times and mandatory kit: in progress.
fiducia.fonti.testo: No estimated values. If something isn't verified, we say so.
fiducia.finisher.titolo: Those who ran it prove it
fiducia.finisher.testo: Finishers verified with Strava or the official results.
fiducia.community.testo: Lift sharing, course recces, finding a pacer.
fiducia.conflitti.testo: Organisers can't review their own race, and sponsored content is always labelled.

iscrizione.testo: Leave your email and we'll write to you when they're online. Nothing else.
iscrizione.presto: In a few days you'll be able to leave your email here, and we'll write to you when they're online.
iscrizione.ok: Done. We've emailed you: confirm your sign-up with the link inside.
iscrizione.errore: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
iscrizione.privacy: We'll use your email only for this notice. Privacy notice
conferma.testo: Thank you! We'll write to you when the first race pages are online. Nothing else.
privacy.intro: How we handle the data of people who sign up to hear when Fair KM opens.
privacy.dati.testo: The email address you enter in the form and the language of the page you sign up from.
privacy.scopo.testo: Only to write to you when the first race pages are online. For any other use we will ask for your consent again.
privacy.base.testo: Your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you confirm by clicking the link in the confirmation email. You can withdraw it at any time.
privacy.fornitori.testo: Emails are sent through Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France), which processes the data on our behalf as a data processor. The site and the form run on Cloudflare.
privacy.durata.testo: Until you unsubscribe. If you don't confirm your sign-up, you aren't added to the list and we won't write to you.
privacy.diritti.testo: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data and withdraw your consent: every email has an unsubscribe link, or write to fair@fairkm.com. You can also complain to a data protection authority; in Italy it is the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali.
privacy.cookie.testo: We use a single technical cookie, lang, to remember the language you choose. Visit statistics are collected with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which doesn't use cookies.
piede.testo: fairkm.com · Trail races at a fair price.
